Please continue with the upgrade to the Magic M. 40T; I will return the Thor P2 as soon as possible. I appreciate your cooperation and will watch for the tracking number of the new unit.

Hi Scott,

Thanks for confirming. Your Magic M. 40T upgrade is set up and reserved for you.

To finish it, please pay the balance using this invoice link. It's the same invoice we emailed you on November 4: (order link hidden)

The total is $335.27. That's the $309.72 balance plus $25.55 sales tax, and your $110.28 store credit has already been taken off.

For the Thor P2, use the UPS label you already have. Keep the unit sealed and write Shop···· on the outside of the box. Your 40T ships December 14, as long as the Thor P2 has reached our warehouse and the invoice is paid. Tracking will be emailed to you as soon as it ships.

Best regards,
Sarah
